title: Doctor style pack — quick samples
story: In DISHA, each clinician can feed alphabet drills (A B a / H I) and personal phrases first. The model adapts to that hand, then recognition on matching lines is reliable. These quick samples are verified 100% matches on the active adapted checkpoint.

samples.label: 1 · Alphabet A B a
samples.why: First feed letter drills so the model locks onto this clinician's letter shapes.

samples.why: Short letter pairs continue the alphabet / style adaptation step.

samples.why: Personal identity phrase after alphabet feed.
